headline: Two Teens Awarded Medals for Rescuing Shark Attack Victim
meta_description: Titus and Yenick received medals this week for their quick thinking when a shark attacked their 14-year-old friend off Thursday Island.
summary_short: Two young rescuers earned recognition this week for their bravery when a shark attacked their mate off Thursday Island.
body:
Two teenagers received medals this week for their swift action during a shark attack that could have ended tragically. Their 14-year-old friend was swimming off the wharf on Thursday Island when a shark bit him.

Titus didn't hesitate—he went into the water and pulled his injured mate to safety. Meanwhile, Yenick ran to alert their friend's mother, triggering the emergency response. Their combined quick thinking and courage transformed a potentially fatal situation into a survival story.

The medals awarded this week recognize what it means to show up for your mates when it matters most. On Thursday Island, two teenagers proved that age is no barrier to heroism.
